subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body and head turned three quarters to the right, black eyes looking at the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: keeps smiling at the camera while the head slowly tilts to one side, further and further, far past a natural angle, the neck bending unnaturally, the smile never changing and the eyes never blinking; then the head snaps back upright in one sudden move and settles into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
